_about: Hand-checked notes for quests Polestar's database has none for: what isn't obvious when you get there. gen.py puts them first on the quest's note (n), before Polestar's. Every entry names where it was checked (src).

<quest ID>.name: quest name, to read the file by
<quest ID>.n: the note, one or two short sentences

92609.name: Feathers in Flight (Horde)
92609.n: The owl nests in the trees hold feathers too: loot them as well as the owls.

95027.name: Feathers in Flight (Alliance)
95027.n: The owl nests in the trees hold feathers too: loot them as well as the owls.
src: in-game check, 2026-11-28 (the Horde's quest; the Alliance's is the same quest from Hnaz Blunderflame)
